messages:
jordan: 🎉 Heads up — our AppExchange listing with Meridiant Health is live: 'Redwood for Clinical Insights' is now published on Salesforce AppExchange. listing: https://appexchange.salesforce.com/listingDetail?listingId=04t5g000003XyzA

maya: amazing!! :tada: big props to the partner team and eng. can we get a short one-pager + customer quote to push to socials and the partner portal?

kevin: nice work everyone. quick note: SSO redirect URI in the install doc had a bad param, patched in the docs repo. snippet I pushed to docs branch:

```
redirect_uri=https://console.redwood.ai/auth/salesforce/callback
# ensure the callback includes the `state` param
```

lia: copying @marketing-bot and @sam. i'll draft a 1-page use case + ROI slide this afternoon. sam — can you confirm the metric we can share publicly?

sam: confirmed with Meridiant: "switched to Redwood inference and saw 3x lower median latency on chart generation workloads; roughly 28% reduction in cost per query" — they're ok with that quote and a short customer blurb.

jordan: perfect. maya, lia — can you coordinate on the press blurb? I'd like a short exec quote from Meridiant's VP of Data if possible.

maya: will do. I'll ask for a 1-2 sentence exec quote and the logo file. planning a small launch post and partner spotlight on Wed.

deploy-bot: automated: scheduled social post queued for 2026-03-28 15:00 UTC (ID: post_8821).

kevin: FYI for eng-runtime folks — we validated the model pinning flow with Meridiant's staging traffic. no perf regressions observed. thumbs up to continue rollout to prod.

lia: tracking: partnership page, one-pager, press blurb, exec quote, blog draft, social assets. assigning tasks in the partnership board.

maya: love it. short internal ask: when the case study lands, please share a /snippet we can drop into the quickstart so sales can demo the flow in-app.

jordan: agreed. final ask — shoutout in tomorrow all-hands (2 slides). adding to the deck now. congrats team!! :rocket:
